A [[Unidentified hostel (Necropolis)|hostel]] on the graveyard world of [[Necropolis (Core Worlds)|Necropolis]] was owned by an '''individual'''. When [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak]] was  kidnapped by Doctor Evazan while he was staying in the hostel with his adoptive uncle, [[Mammon Hoole]], and his sister [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]], Hoole informed the hostel’s owner, who alerted the local authorities.<ref name="GOF">''[[Galaxy of Fear: City of the Dead]]''</ref>
